title: 完整源石锭数值栏补读个位数
diagnosis: On four previously missed sampled changes the full detector did not provide an eligible numeric box. Isolating the same printed glyph made it readable. The slashed zero was sensitive to horizontal versus vertical padding. Repeated prior header amounts also prevented a preview in a verified single-digit case.
implementation: After ordinary reading misses, locate a unique current icon and its complete neutral backing, corroborate a single glyph in its expected alignment and scale with upright OCR on natural and binary crops, and check enclosed strokes. Current HUD labels qualify output. Independent current-plate decoding supports the six verified single-glyph forms 0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. Existing ordinary and prior-mask readers remain available for other values.

native_replay.scope: 15 distinct sampled changes across rewards and shop/investment in one local recording, each stable in at least two half-second samples. Chronological preceding references. Two separate replays of the same changes, not independent sessions. Injected client frames to actual Windows Qt inventory chip Paint. Excludes live capture delay, game load and monitor scanout. Prior midpoint results reused from the baseline receipt; first-sample baseline rerun on its frozen code.
native_replay.stage_scope: Reader elapsed stages on nine two-digit midpoint changes. Whole-sample time also includes later work after first correct paint.

verification.comparison: Other fields unchanged on paired full reads excluding performance, observation timestamp and intended gold additions. Previously confirmed amounts preserved.
verification.native_window: original test window closed normally, updated native toolbar visible and responding
verification.challenge_method: holdout: 81 visually reviewed digit-mask representatives crossed with three confirmed prior screens from the same recording. random: 650 reproducible rectangle placements on five samples. stress: 336 fixed overlays on six samples. These are correlated trials, not an independent population error rate.
verification.counterexample: In six separate deliberately erased crops, a full leading digit overwritten with the exact backing color left the remaining supported digit legible and accepted. Single-frame pixels cannot distinguish that case. No such wrong paint observed among the 15 natural changes.
verification.paired_harness: An initial in-process baseline swap failed in LinearRing construction. Discarded that comparison and ran the frozen and changed readers in separate processes, comparing serialized observation digests.

resampling.method: Six native single-digit changes resized offline to five 16:10 dimensions, then passed through viewport preparation, using the confirmed normalized life-label box. Field reader only. This is synthetic resampling, not a test of native game rendering at each size.
resampling.observed_limit: The 24 non-native-size inputs abstained. 23 did not meet the measured plate geometry and one had a dark resampling artifact.

next: Address the two-digit changes that still wait for full-screen OCR. Verify live capture-to-paint including first entry, more fonts/scales, other counters, game FPS and CPU.
